entry.title: refactor: modularize modal components and eliminate build/test warnin…
entry.content:
refactor: modularize modal components and eliminate build/test warnings (#195)

* refactor: modularize modal components and eliminate build/test warnings

- Extract presentation components from monolithic src/jolito.tsx into dedicated ui modules:
  - src/ui/icons.tsx (SVG icons, brand marks, and flags)
  - src/ui/modals/EditCardModal.tsx (card editing form, audio previews, conflict detection)
  - src/ui/modals/SyncModal.tsx (Supabase auth, magic links, OTP verification, sync status)
  - src/ui/modals/FeedbackModal.tsx (user feedback form, submission feedback)
- Eliminate Vite build warning for node:path externalization in src/domain/anki-sql.ts
- Eliminate React 19 act(...) test warnings in src/jolito.test.tsx:
  - Properly await async operations and event loops during modal interactions
  - Wrap hidden visibilitychange in try/finally to prevent state mutation leaks across tests
  - Correctly await in-flight sync resolution promises within act blocks
- Add comprehensive repository evaluation in docs/REPO_EVALUATION.md

* refactor(ui): extract AudioButton and shared focus utility

- Extract AudioButton into dedicated src/ui/AudioButton.tsx and remove duplicate declaration in src/jolito.tsx
- Extract handleFocusSelect into src/ui/utils.ts to eliminate helper duplication across modals
- Clarify anki-sql.ts boundary stages and modal references in docs/REPO_EVALUATION.md

* refactor(ui): clean up imports and remove redundant component re-exports
